title: YouTube Autocomplete with FlashData
description: Get YouTube autocomplete phrases for one query prefix, language and region. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is separate. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Requires youtube_suggestions access. Get your key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

language.title: Language
language.description: Suggestion language code, e.g. en, de or es.

region.title: Region
region.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, GB or SG.
